spec2def(msacm32.dll msacm32.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# msacm32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msacm32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(msacm32_shims OBJECT driver.c filter.c format.c internal.c msacm32_main.c pcmconverter.c stream.c)
target_link_libraries(msacm32_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libadvapi32 libuser32 libwinmm libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(msacm32_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_compile_definitions(msacm32_shims PRIVATE _CRT_NON_CONFORMING_SWPRINTFS)
set_wine_module_fixme(msacm32_shims)
add_cargo_module(msacm32 msacm32-cargo msacm32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msacm32_shims psdk)
